assumptions.range_channel: ddot R + kappa^2 R = Gamma q_A
assumptions.scope: symbolic projection audit; no empirical data channel

rows.next_requirement: calibrate Gamma or use ratios insensitive to scale
rows.notes: A constant projection cannot create arbitrary frequency dependence. It only rescales c_Y and beta.
rows.verdict: pole relation survives up to one scale

rows.notes: Multiplying by (kappa^2+z^2)/Gamma recovers the same relaxation transfer.
rows.projection_channel: ddot R + kappa^2 R = Gamma q_A
rows.verdict: exactly deprojects to G(z) off projection poles

rows.collapse_condition: too few samples to fit both pole and projection nuisance
rows.notes: The relaxation pole survives, but exact distinguishability must include the shared projection parameters.
rows.verdict: finite nuisance, not arbitrary per-frequency nuisance

rows.collapse_condition: Gamma beta = 0 or projection zero at relaxation pole
rows.notes: At z=-1/tau_chi the numerator of the range transfer is Gamma beta.
rows.verdict: relaxation pole remains in observed transfer

rows.collapse_condition: Lambda_k free at every sampled frequency
rows.notes: Choosing Lambda_k=O_hat_k/(G_k F_hat_k) absorbs the pole point by point.
